executive_ruling: Independent CEO audit discovered that 136R violated architectural separation by branching on target_id and recycling single words across all 4 claim fields. All 7 offers demoted to UNREVIEWED_RAW_CAPTURE.

root_causes.description: claim_binding_engine_136r.js contained explicit if (targetId === "TARGET_136_XX") branching instead of general semantic parsing.
The exact same string (e.g. MUA1TANG1, sinh viên, Student Developer Pack) was recycled across offer, terms, validity, and locality fields.
Nationwide offers lacked formal relational receipts binding the nationwide promotion to official Da Nang physical venue captures.
Test suite only verified substring existence for offer/terms without enforcing semantic differentiation, disjoint offsets, or context windows.
